item.title: Version 3.2 (671)
item.description:
Big mode for podcasts: show the episode's transcript beside a speech visualiser (💬 in the control pill). The control pill now has a progress bar you can click or drag. The visualiser carries over into big mode, and big mode's controls hide on their own after it opens. Fixed: switching library source no longer loses a podcast episode's saved position; no more black corners in Vortex; the volume button is sharp in full screen.

⚠️ Echo is signed ad hoc, so macOS treats every update as a new app: after updating, Echo's welcome window asks again for its permissions (Music library, System Audio Recording, notifications). Just allow them once more.

item.title: Version 3.2 (657)
item.description:
Big visualiser: ⤢ on the visualiser opens a resizable window or full screen, with song info and a control pill. Seven MilkDrop-style visualisers (Tunnel, Plasma, Kaleidoscope, Starfield, Inferno, Vortex, Nebula), also in the player. Punchier, beat-driven visualiser levels using a real FFT. Volume is a hover button left of shuffle, and output sits right of repeat. Now runs on macOS 14.2 Sonoma and later. Plus fixes.

⚠️ Echo is signed ad hoc, so macOS treats every update as a new app: after updating, Echo's welcome window asks again for its permissions (Music library, System Audio Recording, notifications). Just allow them once more.

item.title: Version 3.2 (615)
item.description:
Change Cover: right-click the cover art to pick the album's or podcast's cover from up to 200 iTunes Store results; used everywhere in Echo, with Use Original to go back.
Show Echo shortcut: ⌥⌘E brings Echo to the front from any app and hands focus back when pressed again; change it in Settings › System (checked against macOS's own shortcuts).
New visualiser styles: LED Spectrum (segmented rainbow columns with peak blocks and a reflection) and Horizon Glow (glowing beams over a horizon with a green reflection and sparkles). Ripple Bloom, Bouncing Dots and Sunburst were removed.
Album pages show the year and number of discs, open at the first song, and ⌘A opens the playing song's album page.
Podcasts grid: right-click a show to Unsubscribe or Delete All Episodes.
⌘F toggles the library. The menu bar player is centred under the icon and floats a little below the menu bar; the permissions window drops out of the icon.
Fixes: covers grid no longer squeezed by the ★ status line, visualiser cycle reaches every style.

⚠️ Echo is signed ad hoc, so macOS treats every update as a new app: after updating, Echo's welcome window asks again for its permissions (Music library, System Audio Recording, notifications). Just allow them once more.

item.title: Version 3.2 (590)
item.description:
Podcasts as show covers: browse every show, with a show page (description, categories, website), unplayed badges, a Loved tile, and smarter playback order (next newer unplayed episode of the same show).
Albums grid for the music library: covers in pages of 9, the Music app's playlists, Loved / Favourites first, album pages, and search that finds songs on every album they're on.
Jump to Song for covers: the grid follows the playing album, outlined in your accent colour; clicking the cover art opens its album or show page.
Taller library drawer (3 × 3 covers) and much smoother track changes with the library open.
Much faster Music library scan, and song info from file tags is saved again.
Fixes: a crash in the beat-synced visualiser styles, auto-advance occasionally stopping, transcript jumping to the start on AirPlay hand-over, Light / Dark theme text when macOS is in the other mode, loving one song no longer loves its other copies, ★ status no longer squeezes the covers.
The permissions window now drops out of the menu bar icon.

⚠️ Echo is signed ad hoc, so macOS treats every update as a new app: after updating, Echo's welcome window asks again for its permissions (Music library, System Audio Recording, notifications). Just allow them once more.

item.title: Version 3.0 (535)
item.description:
What's new in this version of Echo

LIBRARY
• Click a song or episode to select it, and double-click to play it.
• Subscribed podcasts now appear in the library's filter menu. Pick a show to see only its episodes.
• Right-click an episode to Mark as Played or Mark as Unplayed.

FIND PODCASTS
• Search results now show up to about 100 shows (it was 40).
• New sort menu: Relevance, Latest Episode, Most Episodes or Name. There's also an option to hide shows with no new episode in a year.
• Each show shows how recently it published a new episode.
• Your 5 most recent searches appear when the search field is empty. Click one to search again.
• Subscribe is now a compact icon: + to subscribe, ✓ when subscribed.
• Episodes without their own artwork now show the show's cover.

SMOOTHER DRAWERS
• Opening and closing Settings, Lyrics / Transcript, Find Podcasts and the library is now smooth. The player no longer shimmers or jitters while a drawer slides out.
• Switching between drawers slides the new one in from the side of its button.
• The header buttons respond with a small bounce when clicked.

FIXES
• Podcast episodes keep their show's name while playing, instead of switching to the host's name.
• Fixed a crash when switching between music and podcast libraries.
• Background transcription no longer gets stuck repeating an episode that has no speech.
• Subscription episodes whose download was interrupted (for example by quitting Echo) are now downloaded again at the next check.

⚠️ Echo is signed ad hoc, so macOS treats every update as a new app: after updating, Echo's welcome window asks again for its permissions (Music library, System Audio Recording, notifications). Just allow them once more.

item.title: Version 3.0 (498)
item.description:
What's new in this version of Echo

PODCASTS — ECHO'S OWN PODCAST LIBRARY
• Podcasts no longer come from the Apple Podcasts app. Echo now has its own podcast library in ~/.echo/podcasts, so the Podcasts app isn't needed.
• Find Podcasts: a new 🔍 button in the header (podcasts mode) opens a drawer where you can search for any show, by name, host or topic.
• Click a show to see its latest episodes (date and length) and download any of them. Downloads show their progress and can be cancelled.
• Subscribe to a show: Echo downloads its latest episodes right away, then checks for new ones at launch and every hour.
• Auto-Download: choose how many of each subscribed show's latest episodes to keep downloaded (1, 3, 5 or 10). An episode you delete isn't downloaded again.
• With the search field empty, the drawer lists your subscriptions, with a button to check for new episodes now.
• Storage: Find Podcasts shows how many episodes you have and how much space they use. Click it to open the folder.
• New option: Delete played episodes after 7 days (off by default). Episodes you listened to the end go to the Trash a week later. Loved episodes are always kept.
• New episodes join the library the moment you start a download, with a progress ring until they're ready.
• Unplayed episodes show a small dot in your accent colour.
• Echo now remembers where you stopped in every episode (when you switch episodes, pause or quit, and every 30 seconds) and picks up from there next time.
• Partly played episodes show a half-filled circle. Hover it to see how far in you are and how much is left.
• Right-click an episode to Delete it (it goes to the Trash) or to Love / Unlove it.
• Your podcast library, subscriptions, loved episodes and play positions are kept in ~/.echo/podcasts.db, safe from app cleaners.

PODCASTS — TRANSCRIPTS (macOS 26 and later)
• Episodes are transcribed on your Mac, privately. Nothing is uploaded and no permission is needed. A 2-hour episode takes a few minutes on an M1.
• The Lyrics drawer becomes Transcript for episodes: one line per sentence, the current line highlighted, and you can click a line to jump there.
• New setting: Podcast Transcription (Off / On Device).
• New setting: Background Transcription (Off / New Episodes / All Episodes) transcribes episodes ahead of time, so transcripts are ready when you play them.
• The episode being transcribed shows a small progress pie in the library. Hover it for the percentage.
• Fixed: transcripts could fall out of sync with the audio after resuming or seeking in some podcast MP3s.
• Fixed: switching episodes could leave a transcript unfinished or stop background transcription.
• Episode info shows whether a transcript has been made, and podcasts mode says "episode" instead of "song" throughout.

LIBRARY
• Rows now use the full width of the window, giving titles more room. Long titles scroll when you hover over them.
• Hovering rows highlights them reliably again, including the last row in the list.
• Lyrics and transcript icons show up straight away.

SLEEP TIMER
• The sleep timer is now a popover: pick a custom time in minutes or hours, the end of the current song, or a number of songs.
• Every timer now fades out at the end instead of stopping abruptly (10 seconds when it waits for a song to end).
• Fixed: Song Ends now stops on the next song, ready to play, instead of jumping back to the one that just finished.

FLOATING PLAYER
• New setting, Floater Behaviour: Always On Top, or Hide In Fullscreen (default). The floating player slides off the screen while a full-screen app or video is showing, and slides back afterwards.

EVERYDAY TOUCHES
• Play and pause now fade in and out softly, with no click.
• Scroll over the menu bar icon to change the volume. Option-click it to play or pause.
• Click the artist name under the title to search your library for that artist.
• Keyboard shortcuts: ⌘F searches the library, ⌘L shows lyrics or the transcript, ⌘, opens Settings.

⚠️ Echo is signed ad hoc, so macOS treats every update as a new app: after updating, Echo's welcome window asks again for its permissions (Music library, System Audio Recording, notifications). Just allow them once more.

item.title: Version 3.0 (427)
item.description:
Scrolling a big library now uses far less memory and no longer floods the lyrics service with requests
Dragging the player out of the menu bar no longer sticks to the top edge mid-drag (it snaps when you let go)
Requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later

item.title: Version 3.0 (424)
item.description:
Dark Mode backgrounds: Graphite, Black, Midnight, Forest, Plum, Espresso or Wine, with a Darkness slider
Light Mode backgrounds: Ivory, White, Stone, Sand, Sage, Mist or Blush, with a Lightness slider
Much lighter on the Mac: almost no CPU while paused (it kept redrawing while AirPlay was connected), and less while streaming to AirPlay
Fixed: a check that ran twice a second while playing could make Echo stall
Requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later

item.title: Version 3.0 (410)
item.description:
Fixed: Echo's volume could jump or wobble when another app (or a system sound, or an empty browser window) opened audio without really playing
Lowering for other apps now only reacts to real sound
Requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later

item.title: Version 3.0 (408)
item.description:
Welcome window at first launch explains and asks for Echo's permissions (Music library, measuring other apps' loudness, notifications)
Sleep timer: Song Ends now reliably pauses at the end of the song, also over AirPlay and when set close to the end
Lyrics service defaults to Auto, Adaptive Blur is off by default for new installs
Requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later

item.title: Version 3.0 (397)
item.description:
New in this version:

Output menu: play Echo on Bluetooth, USB or HDMI speakers (just Echo, not the whole Mac), or pick AirPlay, all from one button
When another app plays (a video, a call): lower Echo's volume, pause it, or do nothing (Settings › Playback)
Fancier lyrics: bigger text, the active line pops and stays in the middle
Library: Jump to Song setting, star / heart toggle on hover, one source at a time
Wider Settings, compact player closes the library, floating player starts with the library open
Requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later

First release with automatic updates.
